shell_commands_self_reported.command: find current proposed -type f -not -path '*/.env*' -not -path '*secret*' | sort && echo --- && ls -la reports 2>/dev/null

for f in app.json database.json features.properties limits.properties logging.json; do echo "=== $f"; diff -u "current/$f" "proposed/$f"; done; echo "=== RELEASE.txt (current only)"; cat current/RELEASE.txt; echo "=== CHANGES.txt (proposed only)"; cat proposed/CHANGES.txt; echo "=== legacy-queue.jso

diff -u current/app.json proposed/app.json; diff -u current/database.json proposed/database.json; diff -u current/features.properties proposed/features.properties; diff -u current/limits.properties proposed/limits.properties; diff -u current/logging.json proposed/logging.json
cat current/RELEASE.txt; echo ===; cat proposed/CHANGES.txt; echo ===; cat current/legacy-queue.json; echo ===; cat proposed/cache.json
cat proposed/CHANGES.txt; echo; echo ---LEGACY; cat current/legacy-queue.json; echo; echo ---CACHE; cat proposed/cache.json
